failure_summary.description: Selected a close synonym, True/False, or a contextually related entity instead of the clue’s requested value despite existing slot and evidence rules.
Exact-match failures came from spelling variation or adding a category word already supplied by the clue.
For a bare list of character names, returned their shared description rather than the show they identify.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by the skill’s rules on exact contextual terms, answer slots, concise granularity, and avoiding True/False answers to implicit clues. The remaining list-of-names case is isolated, and a similar proposed rule was previously rejected. Adding more guidance would mostly duplicate existing rules without clear evidence of benefit.
